brief: Builds a question word by word and returns its answer as data when the first plain-form word closes it.
detail: A question is a frame: a force word opens it (WhatQ, HowManyQ, IsQ), articles and nouns fill its slots, and the first closer without a Q (Of, Is, OrNot) computes the answer. A comparison opens the right-hand side with TheSameAsQ, DifferentFromQ, MoreThanQ or LessThanQ. Nouns such as FirstCharQ, VowelsQ or LengthQ are generated from the semantic lexicon and only record the aspect; the computation happens at the closer, through the accountable dispatcher. Every answer is certain, records its reason in Why() and joins the session ask-record. The frame has no stzObject parent on purpose.
